text: The change adds mail/base/docs, mailnews/base/docs and mailnews/db/panorama/docs to the codespell include list. The accepted configuration retains them alongside its extension filters and explicit exclusions; Calendar and address-book roots are a later phase. These are declared candidates for the external wrapper, not proof that every document was checked or a lint run passed.
title: Spell-check inputs add three documentation roots without changing extension filters
